01 / What we do

Executive search,
built for wealth management.

We recruit for one industry: the firms that look after other people’s money. That focus means we already know the people, the roles and the market before your search begins.

From senior wealth advisors and planners to trust officers, operations leaders and executives, we find people whose skills and values fit your firm, including the many who are not actively looking. Firms also call us for an honest read on who is available, what a role should pay and what competitors are doing.

More about Windward

03 / Our promise

Good connections.
Lasting impact.

Four promises we keep in every search and every conversation.

I

Specialist insight

We know the market.

Wealth management and financial services is all we do. We see the nuances between firms, roles, markets and people that generalists miss.

II

Considered judgment

We say what we see.

Risks, gaps and concerns are raised early and constructively. A disciplined process keeps every search fair, efficient and reliable.

III

Lasting relationships

We stay in touch.

Our network is built through conversation, referral and years of contact, including when there is no placement attached.

IV

Discretion

We protect every name.

Confidentiality is a principle, not a guideline. Candidates stay anonymous and searches stay quiet until the right moment.

05 / Why Windward

The details
make the difference.

Six reasons firms trust us with the hires that matter most.

Discuss your search
  • 01

    Expertise in wealth management and financial services

    We focus on one industry, so we know the firms, the roles and the people. That depth helps us find talent that fits your goals, not just your job description.

  • 02

    Extensive candidate screening

    We go beyond the résumé. In-depth interviews, skills assessments and background checks confirm experience, qualifications and cultural fit before anyone reaches your desk.

  • 03

    Customized solutions

    We learn your requirements, culture and business objectives first, then present a curated shortlist of people who share your values and long-term direction.

  • 04

    Access to top talent

    Our network and proactive outreach reach high-caliber professionals, including passive candidates who are not applying anywhere else.

  • 05

    Time and cost efficiency

    A focused process and efficient screening fill critical roles faster, without cutting corners, so you can stay focused on running the business.

  • 06

    Long-term partnerships

    Many clients trust us with search after search. We measure success by the relationship, not the transaction.

06 / Our approach

Listen closely. Look deeper.
Connect thoughtfully.

A deliberate process for a decision with lasting consequences.

We start with your goals, business context and culture. For a candidate, that means understanding where you want to go and what a better opportunity looks like.

Specialist networks, proactive outreach and careful evaluation identify the people whose skills and expectations truly match the opportunity.

We bring firm and candidate into a considered conversation, support the offer, and stay in touch long after the start date.

Questions and answers

A little clarity
before we begin.

Still have a question? Call us on 414-939-8700

We focus on wealth management and financial services: registered investment advisers (RIAs), family offices, trust companies, asset managers and other financial services organizations. Our recruiting experience also includes the legal industry.

Executive and specialist roles across wealth management, estate, tax and retirement planning, investment and relationship management, accounting, finance and trust. Our open jobs also include operations, service and business development roles.

We go beyond the résumé with in-depth interviews, skills assessments and background checks. Understanding your culture, goals and long-term vision matters as much as checking experience.

Yes. Many of the people we place were not looking when we first spoke. A confidential conversation costs nothing, and we never share your name without your permission.

Use the forms on our For employers and For candidates pages. Both accept documents up to 50 MB. You can also call us on 414-939-8700 or book a 30-minute call.

Every open role is listed on our Jobs page with the full description. Roles change often, so new ones appear there as soon as they open.
